note: Held-out split for the eval. heldOut is frozen before any prompt or threshold tuning; once frozenAt is set, cases only get added, never moved. The first four held-out cases are public photos without a scale reference: they test that the pipeline refuses to invent millimetres. Seven team photos (coin in the crack's plane) were added 2026-10-30 as the first scale cases; DSC_0684 and DSC_0685 are the same crack at two distances and stay in dev together, so held-out has no near-duplicates. None of the seven has a measured length yet, so accuracy on them stays UNSCORED until someone puts a tape on the wall. Photo files stay local in fixtures/photos/ (gitignored); source and license are recorded here.

heldOut.spanNote: 227 mm is the straight-tape chord (tape 127 cm to ~149.5-150 cm in DSC_0711.JPG, range 225-230 mm). A crack path must exceed its chord, so the chord is context only, not path-length accuracy.
heldOut.pinNote: 274 mm pin-to-pin polyline (6 spans 5.2 + 4.8 + 4.5 + 4.2 + 2.9 + 5.8 cm) follows the crack path most closely and is the closest path-length truth. Against it the pipeline reads low: SC-25D35C5E 218.5 mm is 55.5 mm low (-20.3%), second run SC-D8ECE64B 232 mm is 42 mm low (-15.3%). Pins cover the full parapet top-to-bottom including edge zones outside the tape segment, so part of the gap may be extent, not just under-measure - stated as read-low, not as a calibrated error.
heldOut.threadNote: Thread-and-pin 238.8 mm was read on a different horizontal crack with no coin in frame (see comparative PDF section 4) and is NOT comparable to this crack - excluded from scoring.
heldOut.runs: SC-25D35C5E 2026-11-02 218.5 mm [R005] is the archived bench run (bench/runs/terrace-slab-tape-01.json). SC-D8ECE64B 2026-11-04 232 mm [R005] is a second live run on a different photo/date - labeled separately, never conflated. Marketing case-study.json 237.5 mm for SC-25D35C5E was a coin-diameter error (25 mm nominal vs 23 mm used by the bench run; ruler reads 24 mm = 228 mm) and is fixed to 218.5 mm.
heldOut.expected: one crack, coin in the crack's plane, millimetre length with coin receipts
heldOut.note: First tape ground truth. Builder's physical tape reading 2026-11-02: crack spans ~127 cm to ~149.5-150 cm = 22.5-23 cm; recorded 227 mm chord (midpoint). Pipeline Ref SC-25D35C5E measured 218.5 mm (R005): 8.5 mm low vs the chord (-3.7%, inside +-10% on the chord) but ~20% low vs the 274 mm pin path. Model-only guess DSC_0710.JPG (same crack, tape not legible) 315 mm: 88 mm high vs chord (+38.8%, outside), 41 mm high vs pin path (+15.0%, outside). maskId damage-1 is the tap-mask id the PWA sends (pwa/app.js).
